_description: Cross-language contract for releasing a signed event through an application-owned shared replay store.

preparation.eventDigest: lowercase SHA-256 hex over the exact well-formed UTF-8 event string
preparation.timestamp: strict RFC 3339 instant with uppercase T and Z or a numeric offset; optional fraction is 1-9 digits
preparation.expiryBoundary: inclusive; expired only when nowUnixSeconds > expiresAtUnixSeconds

sharedStore.consumeAtomicity: exactly one concurrent caller receives literal true for a new key
sharedStore.consumeExecution: must be nonblocking; Node requires a declared async function and all runtimes require backend I/O to yield or run off the event loop
sharedStore.timeout: helper returns by its configured deadline without releasing payload when a nonblocking backend ignores cancellation; a late backend side effect never authorizes payload release
sharedStore.errorRedaction: backend names, causes, credentials, replay keys, signatures, and payloads are not exposed through public errors or causes

observability.redaction: do not emit backend names or causes, credentials, replay keys, signatures, keys, event JSON, or payload data
